name: Soukyuu no Soleil ~Fullmetal Eyes~
source:
Soukyuu no Soleil is a tactical battle SLG which is the successor to SkyFish’s previous “Valkyrie Saga” titles Shirogane no Soleil and Gouen no Soleil. The story takes place in another world where there is a white and a blue moon in the sky. The humans are constantly fighting magical monsters called ‘berserk’, which are weapons which activate using the souls of humans. Valkyries come from the white moon to aid them in battle. This is where the main protagonist Sora meets the valkyrie Odette on the battlefield and fight alongside one another.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《苍穹的索雷尤》是一款战术战斗模拟游戏，承接SkyFish此前的《女武神传奇》系列作品《白银的索雷尤》与《红焰的索雷尤》。故事发生在另一个世界，那里的天空悬挂着一白一蓝两轮月亮。人类不断与名为“狂战士”的魔法怪物交战，这些武器以人类灵魂为动力启动。女武神从白月降临，协助人类作战。主人公空正是在战场上邂逅女武神奥黛特，并与她并肩战斗。

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/02/13/february-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
